notes.title: Version 0.6.4
notes.content: [h2]📢 Important Notice[/h2][p]This update includes changes to the save files, so it is recommended that you delete your previous game data.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔄 Changes[/h2][list][*][p]The player will no longer spawn at a checkpoint. Instead, your last position will be saved, and when the game starts, the character will remain still. You will have to choose the direction in which you want it to start running (similar to when you get up after a fall).[/p][/*][*][p]User settings will now be saved even if you delete your game data.[/p][/*][*][p]The colliders of collectible objects have been enlarged.[/p][/*][*][p]Character movement has been tweaked in the NPC area.[/p][/*][*][p]The timing of when cloud colliders activate and deactivate has been adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Corrected spelling and grammar errors in both English and Spanish throughout the menu and tutorial sections.[/p][/*][*][p]The menu now closes properly when the camera is moving.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collider issues in the pipe area.[/p][/*][*][p]The character will no longer change direction when interacting with the Moai (this used to happen occasionally).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the character could sometimes pass through walls when trying to return to the Moai.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the backwards double-jump bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where a backward jump played the normal jump animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where the character could change direction mid-air after touching a ceiling during a backward jump.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where only the background of the main menu would appear when returning to the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by the dissolving tree material.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by storage overload.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]If you encounter any bugs or the game crashes while playing, please report them in my Discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/K3SxJAb4KX"]https://discord.gg/K3SxJAb4KX[/url][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.6.2
notes.content: [p]Demo Update[/p][list][*][p]Fixed rendering issues on screens other than 1920x1080[/p][/*][*][p]You can now restart a game from the menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several collision and bounce bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial only appears during the first playthrough[/p][/*][*][p]New difficulty mode “Learning Mode” that doesn’t penalize you when the three days end[/p][/*][*][p]Time nerfed (time now passes more slowly — the 3-day cycle now lasts 47 minutes total)[/p][/*][*][p]VSync enabled[/p][/*][*][p]Grammar mistakes corrected[/p][/*][*][p]Mo’s dialogues in the main level no longer move with him, making them easier to read[/p][/*][*][p]The intro cutscene will only play when starting the game [b]if no save file is found[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New dialogues added when the world is reset[/p][/*][*][p]New bordered screen mode to allow gameplay recording with webcam space that doesn’t cover important game elements[/p][/*][*][p]When resetting the world, you are now sent directly to the main level instead of the menu[/p][/*][*][p]Slight changes to the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Charge will now reactivate automatically when you touch the ground again, if it was active before[/p][/*][*][p]New option in the controls menu: hold the charge button to activate and release to deactivate[/p][/*][*][p]You can now fast-forward through NPC dialogues[/p][/*][*][p]A visual signal has been added to show when the menu cannot be opened[/p][/*][*][p]Improved transition when entering the tree[/p][/*][*][p]Landing smoke effect now appears in the correct position[/p][/*][*][p]New screen brightness option[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs now wake up earlier[/p][/*][/list]
